title: Maxibel Bell Pepper (Condor Maxibel): Characteristics
metaDescription: Maxibel bell pepper is an open pollinated bell pepper variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Maxibel bell pepper is an open pollinated bell pepper variety, also sold or known as Condor Maxibel. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical (Condor brand).

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Maxibel bell pepper is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Condor Maxibel, this is the same bell pepper. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [bell pepper variety finder](/crop-varieties/bell-pepper), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).
Key facts about Maxibel bell pepper

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit bell pepper fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Fruit:** Blocky with thick walls and 3 to 4 lobes.
An improved open pollinated selection with even, vigorous plants.

blocks.text: Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Maxibel bell pepper

Bell pepper does best in cool places such as Benguet and Bukidnon. In the lowlands, pick a heat tolerant hybrid and grow it in the dry season under some shade. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).

Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.

items.q: Is Condor Maxibel the same as Maxibel?
items.a: Yes. Condor Maxibel is another name for Maxibel. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
Yes. It is open pollinated, so seed from a clean, isolated field grows true. Still, certified seed gives the best start every few seasons.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Maxibel?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
